T: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Disgust. And dinner.
D: An 11-year-old's emotions struggle to steer her through a move from Minnesota to San Francisco.
P: Serve the pizza when Riley tries the broccoli pizza in San Francisco.
S: Tray pizza with garlic oil, mozzarella and broccolini
Pizza dough stretched in a tray, olive oil, garlic, mozzarella and broccolini roasted until crisp at the edges, chilli flakes and parmesan. Actually good.
Bing Bong pink fairy floss meringues
the imaginary friend made of fairy floss

Crisp pink strawberry meringue kisses with soft chewy middles, topped with a puff of fairy floss just before serving. Heat the oven to 110C. Whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in 1 tbsp freeze-dried strawberry powder and a drop of pink food colouring. Pipe 24 kisses onto lined trays and bake for 1 hour, then turn the oven off and leave them inside to cool for 1 hour. Top each with a little pink fairy floss right before serving.
Cheddar cream cheese balls rolled in paprika, parsley, sesame and pistachio
Cream cheese and cheddar rolled into balls, each coated a different colour: paprika, herbs, sesame, crushed pistachio and black sesame.
M: home in Minnesota before the move

Beef mince, green beans and corn baked in a creamy mushroom sauce under rows of crisp golden potato gems, with a little cheddar melted over. Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Make a sauce: soften 200g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml milk and 200ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Stir the beef, 200g chopped green beans and 1 cup corn kernels into the sauce and pour into a baking dish. Cover with 700g frozen potato gems in rows and bake for 35 minutes, adding 100g grated cheddar for the last 5.
Family dinner lemon and rosemary chicken
Lemon and garlic rubbed chicken thighs roasted over small potatoes

Chicken thighs rubbed with lemon zest, garlic and rosemary, roasted on a tray of potatoes until the skin crackles, with buttered green beans. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1kg halved small potatoes in oil and salt on a large tray. Rub 8 chicken thighs on the bone with the zest of 2 lemons, 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, oil and salt, and sit them skin side up on the potatoes. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear, then squeeze over the lemon juice. Boil 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream in five colors
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, buttercream split into five bowls tinted yellow, blue, red, purple and green, one colour per cupcake.
K: Strawberry vanilla ice cream shake topped with pink cotton candy
Thick vanilla milkshake blended with strawberry and topped with a puff of pink fairy floss.

veg.n: Family dinner lemon and rosemary haloumi traybake
veg.make_ahead: Zest the lemon and toss the chickpeas with the garlic and rosemary up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in half the oil and salt on a large tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Toss the chickpeas with the lemon zest, garlic, rosemary and the rest of the oil, add to the tray and roast 10 minutes.
Lay the haloumi over the top and roast 12 minutes until golden. Squeeze over the lemon juice.
Boil the beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the cupcakes up to 1 day ahead and keep airtight; make the icing and pipe on the day

steps.text: Beat part of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs and fold in the flour and milk.
Bake in a muffin tin at 175C for 18 minutes. Cool.
Beat the rest of the butter with the icing sugar, split into five bowls and tint each a feeling colour with the food colouring.
Pipe onto the cupcakes.

s.note: Tray pizza with garlic oil, mozzarella and broccolini
s.how: Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled tray. Brush with garlic oil, top with 200g mozzarella and a bunch of broccolini cut small. Bake at 240C for 15 minutes until crisp at the edges. Finish with parmesan and chilli flakes.

s.note: Cheddar cream cheese balls rolled in paprika, parsley, sesame and pistachio
s.how: Beat 250g cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar. Roll into small balls and coat in five colours: paprika, chopped parsley, sesame, crushed pistachio and black sesame. Chill until firm.

m.n: Family dinner lemon and rosemary chicken
m.note: Lemon and garlic rubbed chicken thighs roasted over small potatoes
m.how: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1kg halved small potatoes in oil and salt on a large tray. Rub 8 chicken thighs on the bone with the zest of 2 lemons, 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, oil and salt, and sit them skin side up on the potatoes. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear, then squeeze over the lemon juice. Boil 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream in five colors
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Split buttercream from 150g butter and 300g icing sugar into five bowls, tint yellow, blue, red, purple and green.

d.note: Strawberry vanilla ice cream shake topped with pink cotton candy
d.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 250g strawberries until thick. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a tuft of pink fairy floss just before serving so it starts to melt into the shake.
